title: Article
description: Published article or editorial content with full text, metadata, author information, engagement metrics, and publication status. Used for news sites, magazines, and content platforms.

title.description: Headline or title of the article

slug.description: URL-friendly version of the title used in web addresses

author.description: Full name of the article author

author_id.description: Foreign key reference to the author's user profile

content.description: Full article body text and content

excerpt.description: Short summary or preview text displayed in article listings

category.description: Article category or topic (e.g., Technology, Politics, Sports, Lifestyle)

tags.description: Array of topic tags for categorization and search

status.description: Publication status (e.g., draft, published, archived, scheduled)

views.description: Total number of times the article has been viewed

likes.description: Number of likes or positive reactions the article has received

comments_count.description: Total number of comments posted on the article

featured_image.description: URL to the main image displayed with the article

published_at.description: Timestamp when the article was published

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the article was last modified
